confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Peru's south-coast tourism towns, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain because Paracas has few registered budget options and seasonal rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor, using typical Peruvian bar-to-beer ratios (about 2.5x for cocktails, about 2x for wine). The FX observation comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not independently reopen that page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: small Peruvian coastal tourism towns near Ica, such as Huacachina and Ica city, with prices set between Lima's mid-range and provincial Peruvian pricing. Paracas is a seafood-focused resort town, so its restaurant prices are compared with other coastal Peruvian resort towns. No specific comparable city was checked against live data.
